Contract CoCoMESystem::closeStore(storeID: Integer): Boolean {
	definition:
		s: Store = Store.allInstance()->any(st|st.Id = storeID)
	precondition:
		Store.allInstance()->includes(s) and
		s.IsOpened = true
	postcondition:
		s.IsOpened = false and
		result = true
}
